caption: The drawing depicts a metal and glass lantern with a rectangular base and body, and a rounded dome top. The lantern is constructed from a dull, grayish metal frame with four vertical edges and clear glass panels on each side, allowing visibility of the interior. The top is slightly curved, meeting at the center, where a large circular metal loop is attached, likely for carrying or hanging the lantern. Inside, a cylindrical metal container serves as the fuel reservoir, with two protruding, braided wicks and a small cylindrical cap or knob next to them. The composition is centered and isolated against an off-white, unadorned background. The color palette consists mainly of muted grays, whites, and subtle brown or copper accents.
title: Lantern (Shaker)
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
